text: This might be a silly one. My 3 year old Leo has a temp of 39.2 tonight. Earlier he bumped his head on the edge of the coffee table, cried straight away, gave him a cuddle and he was back to normal in a couple of minutes, still is, running round being a pain. No fit or shaking or jerking or anything like that. He did look a bit purple round his mouth when I went to check him and my heart stopped, but it was just blackcurrant squash, it wiped straight off with a baby wipe and his lips are normal underneath. I don't know if the bump and the temperature together means anything or if I'm just being paranoid
